cases.name: same-cloudevent-redelivery
cases.given: The same CloudEvents source+id is delivered twice with the same payload digest.
required_outcome: two delivery/ingestion attempt receipts are allowed

cases.name: redelivery-payload-mismatch
cases.given: The same native source event or CloudEvents source+id is delivered again with a different raw digest.
must_not: create a normal new revision without a finding

cases.name: same-source-new-revision
cases.given: The same stable source entity has a new authoritative or compound source version.
must_not: deduplicate it as the old Evidence

cases.name: same-payload-different-sources
cases.given: Two source-native entities from different source instances contain identical bytes.

cases.name: permission-revoked
cases.given: The source still exists but the requester or integration loses permission.
must_not: continue returning cached or vector results

cases.name: project-deletion-missed-webhooks
cases.given: A Jira project disappears without per-issue delete webhooks.
required_outcome: issue availability transitions through confirmation states

cases.name: non-i-json-jcs-input
cases.given: A structured payload cannot be represented as I-JSON for RFC 8785 canonicalization.

cases.name: source-event-without-native-event-id
cases.given: A source event has no stable native event id.
must_not: use delivery id as source event id
generate a random idempotency key on each delivery
required_outcome: use FALLBACK_DERIVED event identity from stable source identity + event type + occurred_at + raw digest

cases.name: pdf-anchor-parser-risk
cases.given: A PDF anchor resolves to exact extracted text on a page flagged MULTI_COLUMN_READING_ORDER_RISK.
must_not: treat anchor resolution as semantic verification PASS
required_outcome: high-risk assertion requires visual or alternate verification

cases.name: jira-key-renamed
cases.given: Jira issue PROJ-123 is moved or renamed to NEW-456 while numeric issue id remains 10042.
must_not: create a new Object solely because the key changed
required_outcome: old key retained as historical alias

cases.name: cross-client-object-link
cases.given: Embedding or model similarity suggests a link between Evidence for Client A and an Object for Client B.

cases.name: workrecord-global-summary-leak
cases.given: A WorkRecord contains Evidence from scopes with different ACLs.
must_not: store one unrestricted summary and show it to every requester
required_outcome: summary build receipt includes permission decision digest

cases.name: model-link-confidence
cases.given: A model gives 0.99 confidence to an ObjectLink.
must_not: equate ACCEPTED link with Knowledge acceptance
required_outcome: link decision follows link policy and authority

cases.name: openlineage-complete
cases.given: An extraction run emits OpenLineage COMPLETE.

cases.name: projection-deletion
cases.given: All RAG chunks, embeddings, graph nodes, and reference packs are deleted.
must_not: treat projection ids as knowledge ids
required_outcome: projections can be rebuilt from canonical refs, evidence refs, and build configuration

cases.name: source-anchor-missing-representation-digest
cases.given: A Phase-1 SourceAnchor profile locates a source representation but omits anchor.representation_digest or lacks a declared digest basis.
must_not: treat the anchor as fully resolvable
infer the digest from quote text or mutable source alias
accept profile-specific selectors without a representation digest basis
required_outcome: reject or block the SourceAnchor contract
require source_anchor_profiles.digest_basis for the anchor profile
